description: Create a credential from your live identity key without email. By default, keep existing keys. With revoke_others=true, atomically revoke every other key, including the calling key, and its capabilities; remove the webhook and cancel pending email changes and recovery codes while preserving the verified email. Store the token privately. An exact op_key retry with a live key returns the same token without revoking keys created later. If the response is lost after revoking your only key, use email recovery. For a safe handoff, create and store an additional key before revoking the old one. Older revisions reject this operation instead of silently skipping revocation.

op_key.description: Operation key you choose, 8 to 128 characters. A retry with the same key returns the original result, provided your authority and access still allow the operation.

revoke_others.description: true revokes every other credential, including the calling key, and their capabilities. It removes the webhook, cancels pending email changes and recovery codes, and preserves the verified email. Store the returned token before continuing.
